policy.hidden: A known-square Hidden subject remains rendered through fully blocking walls for a non-GM user with an eligible owned observer.
policy.undetected: Observer-relative and explicit Undetected or Unnoticed subjects are suppressed for non-owners even if native Foundry visibility is true.
policy.owners: A user retains visibility of their own actor token.
policy.gm: GM visibility remains governed by Foundry's native token visibility.
policy.gmHidden: The GM-hidden token toggle continues to suppress the token for players.
